name: pebble-asana-plugin
author: seqian
description: Native Pebble devices destination for Asana tasks

usesPermissions.name: Internet
usesPermissions.reason: To load workspaces and projects and create tasks in Asana

plugin.description:
Capture tasks in Asana effortlessly with Pebble devices.

Turn spoken reminders into Asana tasks without reaching for your phone. Tasks are automatically added to your preferred Asana workspace, with the option to specify a project and due date.

Connect your Asana account securely through OAuth and stay organized wherever inspiration strikes.

This Plugin is a mirror of the Todoist one published by Pebble, adjusted for Asana.

actions.name: create_reminder
actions.description: Create an Asana task assigned to the connected user in the selected default workspace. When no destination is requested, omit instanceId and project_name to use the configured default project, if any. For an explicit destination use instanceId from reminders/list, including My Tasks (no project), or supply project_name for a unique matching accessible project. due_iso is an optional absolute RFC3339 date-time with timezone. When no due date is requested, omit due_iso.

due_iso.description: Optional absolute due instant, including Z or numeric UTC offset

timezone.description: IANA time zone for due_iso; required when due_iso supplied

project_name.description: Optional Asana project name, resolved uniquely in the default workspace
